do.text: Give every field a visible label above it, so it stays when the field is filled.

dont.text: Don't use the placeholder as the label: it disappears as soon as people type.

title: Say how to fix an error

do.text: Write the error as what to do ("Enter a valid email address").

dont.text: Don't write a vague error ("Invalid"): it says something is wrong, not what.
